pages.text: Use the side below the driver’s seat with a cabinet to fit it. Both wagon forms support installation, and its width adapts to the seat.$(br2)A single seat provides 27 storage slots; double and triple benches provide 54. Choose a wood to suit the other parts.

Use either handled drawer end to open storage, even while holding an item. The drawer slides out and returns when its menu closes.$(br2)Sneak-use to remove the cabinet; its contents drop separately. Conversion preserves storage. Removing the seat or hammer-dismantling also recovers the cabinet and contents.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Use six matching planks around a barrel. The planks determine the cabinet’s wood.
